GlycanPredictor — 4-Stage GNN & Constrained Arborescence Assembly

Jointly optimizing Stage 2 [RelationalMPNN][serogen.core.graph.gnn.RelationalMPNN] message-passing over multi-hop CSR operon graphs and Stage 3/4 Constrained Arborescence Potentials (GlycanPredictorParams) via Two-Phase Optuna TPE.

1. Phase 1 Optuna TPE Study: RelationalMPNN Architecture & Message Passing

Tuning hidden dimension, message-passing depth (num_layers), 8-channel acceptor-carbon bilinear tensor rank (bilinear_rank), 2-hop syntenic edges, cosine learning rate, and clamped-node masking probability.

2. Phase 2 Optuna TPE Study: Stage 3/4 Arborescence Potential Blending (GlycanPredictorParams)

Jointly optimizing all 14 biochemical node and directed edge potentials across Cross-Validated (65%) and Pure Sequence De Novo (cluster_id=0, 35%) validation regimes.

3. Held-Out Test Set Evaluation Across Three Generalization Regimes

Comparing Cross-Validated (unseen record, Pan-Locus homology clusters retained), Pure Sequence De Novo (cluster_id=0 stripped), and 1-Free GT Clamped Completion (known_assignments) on held-out test records.

4. Zero-Shot Out-of-Sample Klebsiella pneumoniae KL106 & KL107 Capsule Benchmark

End-to-end prediction directly from raw NCBI nucleotide accessions LT174576.1 (KL106) and KF793263.1 (KL107) segmented de novo by [SeroGen LocusPredictor][serogen.loci.LocusPredictor] (heal_mobile_elements=False) and assembled by [GlycanPredictor][kbank.biosynthesis.GlycanPredictor].
